product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides enterprise employees with AI colleagues that answer questions and automate back-office workflows across HR, IT, finance and procurement.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes Universal Assistant and AI Colleagues Platform pricing structures; numeric prices require a custom proposal.

hq_location.notes: The September 2026 job description explicitly says headquartered in New York, matching the current company address. Its LinkedIn profile instead lists San Francisco.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by VP of Engineering Shubham Agarwal cover the open-source agent benchmark and implementation of Browser Use in Leena AI’s architecture.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes model configuration and a quick-start guide, alongside other product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Engineering Manager – AL/ML, posted September 3, 2026; description explicitly covers production LLM, retrieval and ML systems.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Azure OpenAI; Anthropic; Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic).
model_provider.notes: These providers are explicitly listed in the public model-configuration documentation.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II. HIPAA and GDPR are listed as compliance claims, not independent certifications.

last_funding.notes: IBM Ventures investment announced October 20, 2026. Amount was not disclosed, so amount_usd is omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: IBM Ventures investment announced October 20, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Senior Account Executive – Enterprise posting for the United States, published October 2, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Leena Forge launch announced October 14, 2026; the post says it is live and describes building and testing AI colleagues from requirements.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brent Ludwig announced on September 16, 2026 that he had recently started as VP of Professional Services.
